title: Answer: phenomenal consciousness is the one ontological primitive, and experiences are its self-excitations

statements.text: Consciousness is phenomenal consciousness, what it is like to feel the warmth of fire or see the redness of an apple, and analytic idealism takes it as the sole ontological primitive: nothing exists outside or independent of it. Particular experiences are patterns of self-excitation of this cosmic consciousness, as a dance is nothing but the dancer in motion. Consciousness is never derived from anything else, since physical ultimates have nothing it is like to be them and no fact about them entails a fact about experience.
statements.scope: the 2018 paper The universe in consciousness, the fullest statement of the view in this folder
